block.purpose: Reusable template block with working compilable logic.
how_it_works: BoolInput1 enables the block. When enabled, RealInput1 (clamped 0-100) is compared to RealSetpoint1.
If RealInput1 stays above RealSetpoint1 for IntInput1 consecutive scans, the on delay timer starts
and BoolOutput1 turns on when it elapses. When the condition is lost the off delay turns it off.
When BoolInput1 is FALSE the block resets cleanly.
StatusString always reflects the current operating condition for diagnostics.

inputs.name: BoolInput1
inputs.comment: Block enable, must be TRUE for any logic to run

inputs.name: RealInput1
inputs.comment: Measured process value to compare against setpoint (engineering units)

inputs.name: IntInput1
inputs.comment: Number of consecutive scans RealInput1 must exceed RealSetpoint1 before timing starts

inputs.name: OnDelayTime
inputs.comment: On delay in seconds before BoolOutput1 turns on

inputs.name: OffDelayTime
inputs.comment: Off delay in seconds before BoolOutput1 turns off

inputs.name: SampleTime
inputs.comment: Cycle time of the PLC in seconds, used for timer logic

outputs.name: BoolOutput1
outputs.comment: Output active flag, TRUE when condition confirmed for timer duration

outputs.name: RealOutput1
outputs.comment: Scaled output value, reflects RealInput1 when active, zero when inactive

outputs.name: IntOutput1
outputs.comment: State, 0 = idle, 1 = on delay timing, 2 = active with off delay timing, 3 = active

outputs.name: StatusString
outputs.comment: Diagnostic status string indicating current operating condition

statics.name: InternalReal1
statics.comment: RealInput1 clamped to 0-100 for internal calculations

statics.name: InternalInt1
statics.comment: Scan counter, consecutive scans RealInput1 has exceeded the setpoint

timers.comment: On delay before output turns on
Off delay before output turns off
